title: the Empty Quarter Rising
author: Jonah Sandoval
blurb: Ada Crane, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
